title: BOX OF LEGO PRODUCTS
reason: Under-described: at least three identifiable boxed sets from the mid-2000s (Creator 4893, Racers Ferrari 8673, Knights' Kingdom) plus parts; roughly $80 to $150 if reasonably complete.
findings: One photo; the title only says box of Lego products. Visible: a Lego Creator box (ages 7-12, set number 4893 read on the box, box art a yellow and orange motorbike, a mid-2000s set); a Lego Racers box (7-12, number 8673, box art 'Ferrari F1 Fuel Stop') that is battered with its end flap torn open and parts bags visible; a small blue Knights' Kingdom box (age 6+, set number not legible); a yellow Lego box with yellow bricks showing (number not legible); a spiral-bound Lego model booklet with a Table of Contents page; a Lego-branded plastic drinking cup; loose blue baseplates and bricks; and a paperback 'The Cold War' (not Lego). Whether any set is complete cannot be checked.
condition: Boxes are worn, the Racers box is torn and some boxes are open; completeness and missing pieces unknown.
rescore_note: Mixed Lego with Racers 8673 Ferrari F1 Fuel Stop (Brickset 19/10/2026, https://brickset.com/sets/8673-1: about $54 used, $102 new, currency likely USD), Creator 4893 (https://brickset.com/sets/4893-1: about $11 used, $34 new), a Knights' Kingdom box and loose parts; completeness unknown and one box torn, my estimate about $100 to $150.
